incidents.name: Smart_Bank Loan_Get donation-inflated collateral price
incidents.notes: Loan_Get() sizes required SBT collateral from SBT_Price(), a spot ratio of the bank's own USDT and SBT balances, so a direct flash-loaned USDT transfer into the contract inflated that price and let a 1,966,930 USDT loan be drawn against negligible collateral.

sources.ref: onchain review of verified source Smart_Bank at 0x2b45dd1d...: SBT_Price() = Smart_Bank_USDT_Balance()*1e18/Smart_Bank__SBT_Balance() and _Start() is permissionless; contract created by 0x0c18f53831ad07e24987f02afd40cf3cf2423350 on 2024-06-22, not the attack sender
